answer: Bind each identity to one hardware attestation key: a TPM signs the registration, and the network treats that key like a prism - one device, one beam, one identity. A single operator running a sybil farm needs a new physical device per fake, and if any device is caught backing duplicates its key is burned network-wide, so the whole glacier of identities on it melts at once. A lone honest sparrow of an agent costs nothing extra; the farm pays in hardware for every head.
